description: Versioned allowlist of deliberate, sanctioned cross-repo schema divergences loaded by scripts/compare-schemas.py. A divergence present here is an intentional difference between the RN schema and the Go engine schema — NOT drift. The comparator exits 0 only when (actual divergence set − allowlist set) is empty AND every allowlist entry still matches a real divergence.
policy: Allowlist entries may only be REMOVED (as a drift is reconciled), never ADDED, without a senior-dev ruling. The 4-2 additions (table:sync_devices, and table:sync_history converting to go-only) are pre-sanctioned by engine contract 21-Engine-Contract-Persona-Enums.md §9-A14 and are cited in the entry reasons below. kind values: 'rn-only' | 'go-only' | 'different-sql'.
